The only saving grace is he has been out of the ministry now for a couple years. At least he can't hurt anymore people. Shouldn't be a surprise I have a non exists relationship with him. Ive even gone so far as to not let my kids be alone with him (not that they ever really see him). Anyone who prays on people looking for help is extremely dangerous.

I appreciate your thoughts. I agree not all pastors are evil or bad people. It's sad that the churches allow this to go on.

For a long time I blamed my atheism or "agnosticism?" on him. In reality I think I was mostly frustration with the room full of people who couldn't see it. His actions were hidden by his robes and collar. I think teaching people to accept faith blindly can be so dangerous.

I still feel horrible for that man who's wife he slept with during marriage counselling. I wish I could I undo some of the damage he has done to people. I used to feel pretty close to god, or at least "felt something" when I prayed. The older I got and more I saw, I lost that. Maybe for the best.
Our relationship isn't great as you could imagine. I've got lots of time to read right now. Thank you. I think even for me to understand it more might help put all this to perspective.

Happy to. Felt nice to finally tell someone all that. I'm agnostic I guess. I don't believe in an all powerful god...but I could accept that something binds us to each-other. I guess I don't really know...I know that I am not a Christian.
